title: Epimorphy of the approximation comparison
statement: Let I be small and cofiltered, D:I→Sch have qcqs objects and affine transition maps, and let s exhibit X as its limit. For every abelian etale sheaf F, the canonical comparison q:colim_i p_i^*p_i*F→F of [def-sc-affine-limit-sheaf-approximation] is an epimorphism.

source.place: Proof step 1: Epimorphy of the approximation comparison

proof.text: Choose a final directed reindexing of I^op (Mathlib IsFiltered.exists_directed). Whiskering preserves the limit. Apply finite-diagram descent with the empty finite diagram to descend any qcqs etale object, in particular every affine etale basis object.

The direct images along all projections are jointly faithful on morphisms: evaluate on a descended affine etale basis object and transport equality along its pullback isomorphism. The affine etale inclusion is cover-dense (Mathlib).

If q followed by a and b agrees, precompose with each colimit injection. The counits followed by a and b agree. Transpose by p_i^* ⊣ p_i*; this gives p_i*(a)=p_i*(b). Joint faithfulness gives a=b, proving the cancellation definition of epimorphy.

proof_origin.place: Proof step 1, formalized from the finite-data reconstruction argument; existing library adjunction, stalk and Mathlib limit APIs supply the glue.

Twelve adjunction API results, including left_triangle_components, right_triangle_components, and unit_comp_map_eq_iff. These provide elementary adjunction identities; none is the scheme-limit approximation diagram or its reconstruction theorem.

Twenty-five hits, in module sheaf pullback/free constructions, condensed sequences, topological stalks, and categorical pullback/colimit shape lemmas. No matching etale sheaf inverse-limit approximation theorem.
